**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (sits at/above fallback).**

- The only renewal mechanic in the document is the maintenance term at § 10 (p0065): a "renewable one-year term."
- No automatic renewal exists anywhere (full-text "renew" search returns only p0065), so no non-renewal notice window is imposed on Sparkling and there is no multi-year auto-renewal (no walk-away exposure).
- No renewal price-uplift mechanic exists; fees run through the Fee Schedule and § 10 maintenance is "without additional fees or charges."
- Term structure otherwise favours us: perpetual licence while fees are paid (p0117) and Sparkling may terminate at any time on 90 days' notice (p0118) — not flagged, as it benefits us.
- Noted in rationale only (minor, not redlined): renewal is not expressly stated to require mutual written agreement, and there is no express CPI/3% cap on any renewal-period maintenance fee in Schedule "A" (Schedule not attached).

No redline proposed.
